answer: Each identity locks 70 credits and files a census form for a river reach, sealed in the vault log. The vault auditor replays it each epoch: a duplicate form, or a key with no prior river work, fails and burns the bond. A hollow identity has no verifiable history, so it fails at once. First filing costs 45, the k-th 45+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,042,000 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool, while one honest filing costs 45 and keeps its bond.
